published_source: Shown only in Figure 5 of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2023.4968.pdf, p. 7132; the coefficients are printed only in Online Appendix Table A5, outside the article); no printed value. Authors' code output in authors_code_* / the Stata log. Note updated Nov 4 2026. Earlier: Authors' Stata log logs/2_stata_regressions.smcl and esttab output tables/TABLE_A5_DID_event_log_market_value_baseline.tex in the package; no article text or PDF in the project, so the values are checked against the authors' code output only, not against the printed article.
replication_status: exact (authors' saturated event study with omitted period 0 reproduced; run_spec event model differs by construction, see notes)
event_bins_authors: fully saturated, relative quarters -51..60, no endpoint bins; omitted: relative quarter 0
notes: Figure 5 / Table A5 column 1: xtreg ln_mkt_val sinceAPIq_F51..sinceAPIq_F1 sinceAPIq_L1..sinceAPIq_L60 i.date, fe vce(cluster gvkey) (replication_package_MS-INS-22-01020/programs/2_stata_regressions.do line 472), fully saturated in relative quarters -51..60 with the ADOPTION QUARTER (relative quarter 0) OMITTED, not -1; N = 133,303 (xtreg keeps singletons and the 11 merge duplicates); never-adopters have all indicators 0. The figure and Table A5 report relative quarters -8..8. fixest on the authors' row-level sample reproduces every reported coefficient (max |diff| 4e-8) and SE, with the authors' omitted period 0 (exact). Authors' path (relative to quarter 0): -8 -0.0643, -4 -0.0697, -2 -0.0232, -1 -0.0006, 1 0.0376, 4 0.0652, 8 0.1260; average over 0..8 = 0.0662 relative to quarter 0 and 0.0668 relative to quarter -1; average over -8..-2 relative to -1 = -0.0528. Because the authors' model is saturated, moving their reference from 0 to -1 only shifts every coefficient by the quarter -1 estimate (-0.0006). DEVIATIONS IN run_spec (pipeline convention, no reference-period option): (i) reference period -1 (authors: 0; recorded in event_omitted_period_authors); (ii) window -8..8 with endpoint bins (relative quarters <= -9 and >= 9 pooled), while the authors saturate -51..60; (iii) the 16 adopters with pre-2007 adoption are dated at 2007Q1 (run_spec maps pre-sample adoption to the first sample period). fixest replication of the runner's TWFE event model: post average (0..8) = 0.049614 raw = 0.019783 SD (0.053245 with the true event time of the pre-2007 adopters), pre average (-8..-2) = -0.046176. Pre-period coefficients beyond -9 trend strongly downward in the authors' saturated model (e.g. -0.39 at -22, -0.97 at -36), so the -9 endpoint bin absorbs a pre-trend. Data: shipped analysis_dataset/api_compustat_gvkey_quarterly_sictreated.dta (Compustat x ProgrammableWeb firm-quarters, original data), rebuilt in R following 2_stata_regressions.do lines 121-262: drop if ln_mkt_val missing or sic_code empty (133,292 firm-quarters, 4,748 firms, 2007Q1-2020Q3 = Stata %tq 188-242, 55 quarters); date = quarterly(year, quarter); api_treat_date_q = qofd(api_treat_date); sinceAPIq = date - api_treat_date_q; dmerge gvkey dateq using hacks.dta (1:m, _merge == 2 dropped) adds 11 duplicate firm-quarters (11 firm-quarters each matched to two PRC breach events; 133,303 rows). Prepared file ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2023.4968/api_panel_collapsed.rds collapses the 11 merge duplicates to one row per firm-quarter (outcome = mean of the duplicated rows; all other columns identical within the duplicates) with frequency weight w_mergedup = number of authors' rows (2 for 11 firm-quarters, 1 otherwise). This reproduces the authors' row-level OLS exactly (identical normal equations and cluster scores) while giving the runner a proper firm-quarter panel: with the duplicates kept, estimators.R's anyDuplicated(id, t) > 0 test would switch CSA to the repeated-cross-section att_gt(panel = FALSE) path for a firm panel. The authors' row-level sample is kept in api_panel_authors_sample.rds. Treatment: gvar = api_treat_date_q (quarter of first public API); api_treat_post equals 1[date >= api_treat_date_q] in every row (verified), 0 for the 4,569 never-adopters, absorbing (no switch-offs). Full sample: 179 adopters with 50 distinct adoption quarters (2005-2019); 100 switchers in 41 cohorts observed before and after adoption; 74 adopters treated at their first observed quarter (always-treated; 16 adopted before 2007Q1 and are dated at 2007Q1 by run_spec's gvar mapping); 5 adopt after their last observation. Never-treated firms: 96.2% of firms, 95.0% of rows. Unbalanced panel (entry/exit), so run_spec uses the composition-fixed CSA cells. Cluster gvkey as published. reghdfe drops 101 singletons (published N); run_spec keeps them (same point estimate).

event_structure.source: programs/2_stata_regressions.do lines 180-190 and 469-472: xtreg ln_mkt_val sinceAPIq_F51..sinceAPIq_F1 sinceAPIq_L1..sinceAPIq_L60 i.date, fe vce(cluster gvkey); sinceAPIq = date - api_treat_date_q = rel (Stata %tq quarters 188-242, consecutive); the adoption quarter (sinceAPIq_0) is omitted; never-adopters have all indicators 0. Observed rel spans exactly -51..60, so nothing is uncovered. The article (Equation (2), Figure 5) reports quarters -8..8 with quarter 0 the reference; Online Appendix Table A5 prints the 16 coefficients.
event_structure.verified: fixest with this structure reproduces the 16 Table A5 coefficients on the authors' row-level sample (N 133,303) and on the collapsed weighted panel (N 133,292, weight w_mergedup), max abs diff 4.2e-08 (SE 6.2e-08), using the true adoption quarter of the 14 pre-2007 adopters (557 rows; in gvar). Dating them at 2007Q1 instead moves the coefficients by up to 0.049.

post_summary_note_nov2: Hull's post summary averages the 8 post coefficients 1..8 (relative to quarter 0): 0.074459 raw. The earlier authors_code.post_avg_0_8_ref0 = 0.066186 is (sum of b1..b8)/9, i.e. it also averages the reference quarter's 0; neither number is printed in the article.
presample_adopters_nov2: 14 adopters (557 rows) adopted before 2007Q1; their true adoption quarter is in gvar (api_treat_date_q), so no adoption_var is needed.
